verdicts.reason: Best-of-breed alternatives to single global ERP instances; 2011 Almost-Enterprise Applications (lightweight business-led apps) and End of the Death of ERP are different claims.
SOA moving into business strategy; Outside-in Architecture (2012) is about share-versus-own ecosystems.
Big data in the enterprise; Finding the Face of Your Data (2013) is visualisation and human insight, not the same phenomenon.
Personalised, contextual digital engagement narrows one step to dimensional marketing (personalised omnichannel customer engagement).
Self-managing, labour-less IT platforms continue as Inevitable architecture (cloud, containers, automated flexible architecture).
AGI on the 5+ year horizon continues as Exponential intelligence (toward broad, deep reasoning) in the 2020 horizon chapter; low certainty.
Quantum listed again as Quantum and then some; wording variant.
